$comment: Provenance manifest for source documents in data/raw/. Every PDF committed here must have an entry. 'official_source' is the canonical government URL; 'retrieved_from' is the URL the bytes were actually downloaded from (Wayback Machine snapshots of the official URLs, because dole.gov.ph serves a Cloudflare browser challenge to non-browser clients). Status values: text_extracted | ocr_required | pending.

documents.title: Rules Implementing Articles 106 to 109 of the Labor Code, as Amended (contracting and subcontracting)
documents.notes: Official upload is a scanned image PDF with no text layer (13/13 pages empty).

documents.title: Implementing Rules and Regulations of Republic Act No. 11058 (Occupational Safety and Health Standards Law)
documents.notes: Scanned image PDF, no embedded fonts. The 2020-10-22 Wayback snapshot of the same URL is truncated at exactly 1 MiB; use the 2021-03-07 snapshot recorded here.

documents.title: Implementing Rules and Regulations of Republic Act No. 11165 (Telecommuting Act)
documents.notes: Scanned image PDF, no embedded fonts. ('Reulations' typo is in the official filename.) This is the telecommuting IRR; DATA_SOURCES.md previously misattributed telecommuting to a 'DO-219-21'.

documents.title: Labor Code of the Philippines, Renumbered (DOLE Department Advisory No. 1, Series of 2015)
documents.notes: Canonical renumbered edition. Scanned image PDF (154/154 pages empty). The 2017 DOLE edition (LaborCodeofthePhilippines20171.pdf, 141 pages, 25 MB) is also a scan and was not kept to limit repo size.
